title: WTO | How to contact the WTO
content:
All questions related to the work of the WTO should be addressed to the enquiry points indicated below. Please first check the website to see if you can find the answer to your question there. Any feedback on the site can be addressed to the Webmaster (see below).
Copyright and permission requests
Guided tours of Centre William Rappard
For all general enquiries, please include your full name and contact  details -
postal address, email address and daytime telephone number
.   We will not reply to anonymous correspondence.
Media enquiries should be addressed to the Press Unit of the Information and External Relations Division:
